name: Patient Name Asked
description: Did the doctor ask the name of the patient?

name: Patient Age Asked
description: Did the doctor ask the age of the patient?

name: Patient Gender Asked
description: Did the doctor ask the gender of the patient?

name: Doctor Name Conveyed
description: Did the doctor convey his/her name?

name: Doctor Qualification Conveyed
description: During the call, did the doctor inform the patient about his/her qualification like, MBBS/endocrinologist, etc.

name: Patient Consent Asked
description: Did the doctor take consent from the patient to proceed for consultation with Tata1mg?

name: Facilitated By Tata1mg
description: Was it conveyed that the call is facilitated by Tata 1mg?

name: ERx Approval Conveyed
description: Did the doctor convey that they are approving the eRx?

name: Patient Details Matched
description: Did the patient name, gender and age match between audio and prescription?

name: Medicine Duration Matched
description: Does the duration (No of days) of medicine in the eRx match with the duration of the medicine mentioned in the audio call?

name: Medicine Frequency Matched
description: Does the frequency (no of Times) of medicine in the eRx match with the frequency of the medicine mentioned in the audio call?

name: Medicine Dose Matched
description: Did the dose of the medicine mentioned on the eRx match with what was conveyed to the patient on the call?

name: Diagnosis Medicine Match
description: Is the diagnosis mentioned on the prescription matching with the medicine (Mentioned in the prescription) use?

name: Symptoms Matched
description: Are the symptoms in the eRx matching with that conveyed on call by the patient?

name: Last Visit Asked
description: Did the doctor ask about the last visit by the patient to his/her treating doctor?

name: Allergic Condition Asked
description: Did the doctor ask about any drug/medicine or any food/allergy ?

name: Medicine Name Conveyed
description: Did the doctor convey the name of the medicines that have come for consultation from the cart?

name: Symptoms Asked
description: Did the doctor ask about the current symptoms, disease that the patient is suffering from?

name: Medical History Asked
description: Did the doctor ask about any previous medical history, like surgery, disease like hypertension, diabetes, chronic kidney disease, thyroid, Medication history anything other than current disease?

name: Symptoms Duration Asked
description: Did they ask about the duration of current symptoms of all the prescribed medicines?

name: Medicine Usage Conveyed
description: Did the doctor inform the patient on how to take medicine by conveying medicine names, duration, frequency & dose?

name: Medicine SKU Matched
description: Did the SKU Full name of the medicine mentioned on the eRx match with what was conveyed to the patient on the call?

name: Cart Medicines Symptoms Asked
description: Did the doctor ask about the symptoms according to the added medicines in the cart but didn’t require consultation?
